seoTitle: Invisible & Blank Character Generator (Copy Empty Text)
metaDescription: Copy invisible Unicode characters such as the Hangul filler, Braille blank and zero-width space, with a table of what each one is.
intro: Get a blank-looking string to paste into a name, bio or message field, and see which character you are using.
why:
The tool lists thirteen invisible or blank characters (zero-width space, joiner, non-joiner, word joiner, BOM, no-break and various spaces, Hangul fillers, Braille pattern blank) and repeats the one you choose. The generated text is shown between arrows so you can select it.

Whether a site accepts blank text depends on its validation; many reject zero-width characters but accept the Hangul filler or Braille blank. Using blank text to impersonate someone or evade moderation can breach a service's rules.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Set how many times to repeat it.
Select the text between the arrows and copy.
Paste it where you need it.

faq.a: U+3164 (Hangul filler) and U+2800 (Braille blank) are commonly accepted; zero-width spaces are often stripped.
